prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Manuel, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Manuel thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is now strictly enforcing massive, immediate fines for any bins left on the sidewalk, so be extremely careful. I’ve heard they’re patrolling constantly, and you will absolutely be penalized if your bin is out even for a second."
text: My neighbor who works at the city council just confirmed they are strictly enforcing massive, immediate fines for bins left on the sidewalk. They’re patrolling constantly, so please be careful since we clearly don't need even more rules.
